certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — EV Battery Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Explain lithium-ion cell chemistry, construction and key parameters
Describe how cells, modules and packs are assembled and interconnected
Explain the functions of a battery management system
Analyse state of charge, state of health and cell balancing
Describe battery thermal management and safety including thermal runaway
Evaluate degradation, second-life and recycling considerations

integrative_case: A pack engineering team must specify a 400 V traction battery for a mid-size EV: they must choose a chemistry and configuration, define BMS protections and balancing, and design thermal management that limits runaway propagation.
